content.short: User-friendly, fast, decentralized Cardano NFT marketplace | Bringing revolutionary NFT smart contract solution.
content.description:
Welcome to JamOnBread, not only a delightful snack but also a decentralized NFT marketplace built on Cardano. Our platform offers a revolutionary smart contract solution that facilitates fair profit distribution among users, projects, and marketplaces.

Our smart contract incorporates multiple on-chain affiliate levels and dynamically splits transaction fees based on various factors. These factors include the marketplace where the NFT was listed, the marketplace where the sale occurred, and the contributors involved in the NFT sale (link affiliate).

Unlike traditional smart contracts, where transaction fees are exclusively received by the contract owner, our approach is different.

Our mission is to give the community a feature-packed and easy-to-use marketplace to interact with their NFTs and at the same time attract people from outside of the Cardano ecosystem to join Cardano’s NFT revolution and discover its advantages.
